none: PAS FindID 993241: Roman copper-alloy nummus of Constantine I (AD 306-337) dating to the period AD 326-328 (Reece period 16).
contea di ritrovamento: Wiltshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTAN-TINVS AVG ; R/ PROVIDEN-TIAE AVGG

A Roman copper-alloy nummus of Constantine I (AD 306-337) dating to the period AD 326-328 (Reece period 16). PROVIDEN-TIAE AVGG reverse type depicting a campgate with two turrets, star above. Mint of Lugdunum. RIC 225. Obverse description: Laureate bust right. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN-TINVS AVG. Reverse description: A campgate with two turrets, star above. PLG in exergue. Reverse inscription: PROVIDEN-TIAE AVGG. Dimensions: diameter: 17.65mm; weight: 1.48g
